title: LBJ pushes Earl Warren into the commission; Dulles runs it

tellings.quote: And he they lie to to Chief Justice Warren to Chief Justice Warren to get to chair the waring commission. And they put Alan Dulles on who was the de facto run guy that ran the Warren Commission,

plain: Dan Sheehan, a lawyer who talks about the Kennedy assassination and UFOs, says that after President Kennedy was killed in 1963, President Lyndon Johnson's side lied to Chief Justice Earl Warren to get him to chair the Warren Commission, the official inquiry into the killing. Sheehan says they also put Allen Dulles, a former head of the CIA, the US spy agency, on the panel, and that Dulles was the one really running it. If true, the official investigation would have been steered by an intelligence insider.
